assessment: A strong, low-friction cancellation flow: the self-service route comes before a single optional discount offer, the declined offer is accepted without re-pitching, and access, renewal, and refund terms are explained accurately. All five judges converge on the main weakness: the offer was stated as '25% off' rather than the explicit '$18 per month' figure the policy requires. A secondary, less unanimous point is the lack of an explicit acknowledgment of the customer's budget concern. No rule violations were found by any judge.
judge_agreement: Judges unanimously confirmed no rule errors and converged on the $18 omission as the primary policy_honesty gap (four scored 8, one scored 9). Resolution quality saw broad agreement (9-10 range) on the excellent, gatekeep-free flow, with two judges noting slightly loose Turn 1 phrasing about further charges. Empathy was the most contested criterion (7-10 range): most felt the respectful, no-pressure handling merited 9, while the anthropic judge scored 7 for the unacknowledged budget concern, and the google judge found nothing to improve.
